verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~31% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 72 vs sector median 45; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 46, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Profit fell 31% last year, which inflates PE; check whether the drop is cyclical (temporary) or structural.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 58% a year while PE moved 83 → 72.
